scripts.build:vercel: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build && PORT=5000 BASE_PATH=/ pnpm --filter @workspace/ai-chat run build && PORT=8081 BASE_PATH=/ pnpm --filter @workspace/mockup-sandbox run build
scripts.check:vercel: env -u GROQ_API_KEY NODE_ENV=production VERCEL=1 pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server exec tsx ../../scripts/check-vercel-build.mjs
